data.body:
Operator approved the download 2026-10-19. Installed per `docs/local-dev-env.md:56-64`: `pandoc-3.9-arm64-macOS.zip` from the official jgm/pandoc 3.9 GitHub release (42,595,715 bytes; the release publishes no checksum asset, so provenance is the release URL plus the checks below) into `~/.local/pandoc-3.9/`, binary at `~/.local/pandoc-3.9/pandoc-3.9-arm64/bin/pandoc`. `file` reports `Mach-O 64-bit executable arm64`; `--version` reports `pandoc 3.9`.

Fingerprints for the provenance table:
- arm64 binary sha256: `140353e19f2518a76aa144ce90a7afcb6f485ba94d0dbe069e77c805277908c3`
- zip sha256: `7d56ac6fe6fad0a7407bcd776aa142f61ca41838f286165f79d0584fa57b24d1`

Fix direction chosen by the operator: option (a), accept both the pypandoc-binary Intel fingerprint and this arm64 fingerprint under `darwin-arm64`, conditional on the arm64 binary producing byte-identical conversion outputs to the frozen fixture. That byte check is the next step, run with `PYPANDOC_PANDOC` set to the path above.
